verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line saying Bugbot Teams includes "analytics and reporting." Nothing describes what those analytics show, so the org-level dashboards in the story are only glancingly evidenced. The 80% resolution-rate figure in the blog is a vendor-wide statistic, not a per-org dashboard metric. Missing for 10: documented dashboards showing findings counts, acceptance/resolution rates per org, review coverage across repos, any detail on the analytics UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
